headline: Meituan 2026 Q2 Report: Revenue Grows 14.4% to RMB 104.6 Billion, Driving AI Integration into Real Business Scenarios
summary: Meituan reported second-quarter 2026 revenue growth of 14.4% to RMB 104.6 billion. The report highlighted integration of AI into its real business scenarios.
why: Meituan is a Beijing-based food delivery and local services platform, and its quarterly results are closely watched as a gauge of China's consumer and local services demand.
